notes: Watch-list of words the lexicon rates known in one sense while the text may use another the A2 reader does not know.

nl-check lists every hit under 'Senses to check'; the reviewer reads the sentence and decides. A wrong-sense hit is a must_fix when the reader gets the wrong image, otherwise a should_fix of kind wrong-sense.
Matched on the resolved lemma, or on a surface form in 'forms' (for words the lemmatiser maps elsewhere: gepast -> passen, lagen -> liggen).
Evidence: experiments/analysis-findings.md §1.2 (aankomen, gepast, gebonden), §2.1 (vertrok, geest, lagen, wisten het niet meer, hele).

words.watch: gain weight; matter (het komt aan op); hit hard (dat kwam hard aan)
layer (noun); 'lagen' is also the past of liggen
appropriate, fitting — unknown adjective, read as 'tried on'
excuse, pretext (use smoes)
commit oneself (zich verbinden met/aan); bandage
twist, contort (zijn mond vertrok)
quite, rather (behoorlijk moe)
definitely, certainly
a certain (een zekere meneer); surely (je bent zeker moe)
neat, decent; just now vs exactly (net zo); net (noun)
contrast particle (ik wel); softener (dat is wel goed); 'well' in questions
equally (even groot); softener in requests
softener (kijk eens); agree (het eens zijn); niet eens = not even
even (nog groter); another (nog een); nog niet vs niet meer
imperative of horen in the same text; check which one
come on! (toe nou); naar … toe; wat doet dat ertoe
mind (een menselijke geest = a human mind)
bound book / hardback; obliged
whole (een hele wereld = a whole world, read as 'a very world')
quite, fairly (best goed); fine by me (dat is best)
simply, just (hij deed het gewoon) — also an intensifier the bible forbids
surely, after all (dat weet je toch); contradiction (wel toch)
takes no object: 'studeer het' is not Dutch (bestuderen)
